title: Disentangling Graph Topology from Cross-Flow Context in Flow-Level Intrusion Detection: code, per-run records and derived data
description: Code, per-run result records and derived data for the article "Disentangling Graph Topology from Cross-Flow Context in Flow-Level Intrusion Detection". Contains every script that produced a reported number, one JSON record per training run, the generated tables and figures, dataset provenance and checksums, and the pre-registered prediction for the untouched holdout, recorded before any model was trained on it. The three public captures are not redistributed; their checksums and the exact file lists used are included instead.
